title: 51happier
description: On May 1st, all furnaces, blast furnaces, and smokers smelt twice as fast. Automatic – no player action required.
body:
Boost your production on Labor Day! This datapack doubles the smelting speed of every furnace‑type block.

· Affected blocks: Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker.
· Activation: Automatically enabled on May 1st (real date via TimeLib).
· Mechanism: Adds 1 extra CookTime per tick, exactly doubling the speed.
· Performance: Only active when at least one player is online on May 1st; otherwise idle.
· Dependencies: TimeLib – timezone configuration required.

Install, reload, and enjoy double‑speed smelting every May 1st. Compatible with any furnace setup.

---

在劳动节提升您的生产效率！本数据包使所有炉类方块的烧炼速度加倍。

· 影响方块：熔炉、高炉、烟熏炉。
· 激活方式：5月1日自动生效（通过TimeLib获取真实日期）。
· 实现原理：每tick额外增加1点CookTime，精确实现速度翻倍。
· 性能优化：仅当5月1日有玩家在线时激活，其他日期完全空闲。
· 依赖项：TimeLib – 需配置时区。

安装并重载后，每个5月1日即可享受双倍烧炼速度。兼容任何炉子配置。
